content:
I'll add the logs bucket following knr-ops conventions. Quick note: `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the Crossplane group; ACK's is `s3.services.k8s.aws` — I'll use ACK's correct group since the repo uses ACK.

## New files

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml` (base)

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  name: myapp-logs  # patched per-env to myapp-logs-dev / myapp-logs-prod
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

### `infra/s3/logs/publicaccessblock.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
spec:
  bucketRef:
    name: myapp-logs
  blockPublicAcls: true
  blockPublicPolicy: true
  ignorePublicAcls: true
  restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml` (base)

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  # Trust policy patched per-env with the correct OIDC provider
  policies:
    - policyRef:
        name: myapp-logs-rw
---
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
            "s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation",
            "s3:GetBucketVersioning", "s3:ListBucketVersions"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}/*"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
```

### `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - publicaccessblock.yaml
```

### `infra/iam/logs-irsa/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
```

### `overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../../infra/iam/logs-irsa
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
  - target:
      kind: Role
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"},
              "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
              "Condition": {"StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }}
            }]
          }
```

### `overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml`

Same structure with `myapp-logs-prod`, prod account/OIDC provider, and identical least-privilege policy scoped to `myapp-logs-prod` (no wildcards).

### `flux/kustomization-logs.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs   # prod instance lives in prod's flux dir
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops            # existing source
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
```

(For prod, a second Kustomization `s3-logs-prod` pointing at `./overlays/prod/logs` — kept separate so dev/prod reconcile independently per acceptance criterion 7.)

### SOPS

No secret values are needed for the bucket itself. If the OIDC thumbprint or account IDs are considered sensitive, store them in `overlays/<env>/logs/secrets.enc.yaml` (SOPS-encrypted) and reference via a Flux-decrypted Secret; nothing plaintext in Git.

## Directory summary

```
infra/s3/logs/{bucket,publicaccessblock,kustomization}.yaml
infra/iam/logs-irsa/{role,kustomization}.yaml
overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml
overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml
flux/kustomization-logs.yaml
```

This satisfies: versioning ✅, AES256 SSE ✅, full public access block (both in Bucket spec and dedicated PAB resource) ✅, IRSA role with least-privilege R/W scoped to the exact bucket ARN ✅, and independent Flux reconciliation of the logs resources ✅.
